event.contact.subscribed.message: A contact joined a list (after double opt-in when it's on).
event.contact.subscribed.note: what a webhook event means, in Settings › Webhooks

event.contact.unsubscribed: A contact left a list or unsubscribed from everything.
event.email.sent: A sending provider accepted a message.
event.email.delivered: The mailbox provider accepted the message.
event.email.deferred: Delivery was delayed and will be retried.
event.email.bounced: Hard or soft bounce, with the provider's original code.
event.email.complained: The recipient marked the message as spam.

event.email.opened.message: A human open (machine opens carry machine: true).
event.email.opened.note: machine: true is a field of the payload, never translated

event.campaign.paused: A send paused, by a person or automatically.
event.approval.decided: A send was approved, rejected or sent back.
event.provider.down: A sending provider is failing or unreachable.
event.provider.recovered: A sending provider is healthy again.
event.message.sent: A sending provider accepted a transactional message.
event.message.delivered: The mailbox provider accepted the message.
event.message.deferred: Delivery was delayed and will be retried.
event.message.bounced: Hard or soft bounce, with the provider's original code.
event.message.complained: The recipient marked the message as spam.
event.message.rejected: Stopped before sending: suppressed or opted out of its category.
event.message.failed: Every provider in the route failed after the retries.
event.message.opened: The message was opened (templates with open tracking).
event.message.clicked: A tracked link was clicked (templates with click tracking).
event.message.cancelled: A scheduled message was cancelled before its send time.

notify.failingBody.message: {count, plural, one {# delivery failed} other {# deliveries failed}} since {since} ({status}).{dead, plural, =0 {} one { # was given up on.} other { # were given up on.}} Open the endpoint to see why.
notify.failingBody.note: since: when it started failing; status: HTTP 502, or the network error

event.form.submitted: A signup was confirmed (at once for single opt-in), with the form and the answers.
event.referral.counted: A referral counted: its subscriber confirmed and stayed through the hold.
event.referral.held: A referral was held for review by a suspicion rule.
event.referral.not_counted: A referral didn't count, with the reason.
event.referral.reward_sent: A reward went to a referrer (a download, a code, a claim link).
event.referral.reward_failed: A webhook reward failed after 6 hours of retries.

problem.managed.message: This endpoint is managed by {integration}. To change it, change the workflow in {integration}, or disconnect {integration}.

problem.unknownEvent.note: event: what was sent, in quotes

problem.onlyFailed: Only failed deliveries can be retried.

problem.eventNeeds.message: {event} carries data you can't see in ReputeCast: it needs “{permission}”.{ask, select, yes { Ask {helpers}.} other {}}
problem.eventNeeds.note: why an endpoint can't take an event; event: an event name such as contact.updated, never translated; permission: a permission's name as the role editor shows it (View contacts); helpers: names joined as 'A or B'

problem.patternNeeds.message: {pattern} includes {event}, which carries data you can't see in ReputeCast: it needs “{permission}”.{ask, select, yes { Ask {helpers}.} other {}}
problem.patternNeeds.note: pattern: what was picked, such as contact.* or *; event and permission as in problem.eventNeeds

problem.eventScope.message: {event} carries contacts from every list, and your access is limited to some lists.
problem.eventScope.note: why an endpoint can't take an event; event: an event name such as contact.updated, never translated

problem.patternScope.message: {pattern} includes {event}, which carries contacts from every list, and your access is limited to some lists.
problem.patternScope.note: pattern: what was picked, such as contact.* or *; event: an event name, never translated

paused.left.message: ReputeCast paused this endpoint: {name}, who set it up, is no longer an active member, and it sent its events on their behalf. Resume it to send them on yours.
paused.left.note: why an endpoint is paused, under it in Settings › Webhooks; name: a member's name

paused.lacks.message: ReputeCast paused this endpoint: {name}, who set it up, can no longer see what {event} carries (“{permission}”). Resume it to send its events on your behalf.
paused.lacks.note: name: a member's name; event: an event name, never translated; permission: a permission's name as the role editor shows it

paused.scoped.message: ReputeCast paused this endpoint: the access of {name}, who set it up, is now limited to some lists, and {event} carries contacts from every list. Resume it to send its events on your behalf.
paused.scoped.note: name: a member's name; event: an event name, never translated

delivery.demo.message: Demo endpoint: ReputeCast never sends demo data. Point it at your own URL to receive events.
delivery.demo.note: why a demo endpoint's delivery failed, in the delivery log

delivery.invalidUrl.note: why a delivery failed: its address can't be requested

delivery.payloadNeeds.message: This delivery carries data you can't see in ReputeCast, so its payload and the endpoint's answer stay hidden: it needs “{permission}”.
delivery.payloadNeeds.note: in the delivery log, instead of a delivery's JSON; permission: a permission's name as the role editor shows it

delivery.payloadScope.message: This delivery carries contacts from every list, and your access is limited to some lists, so its payload and the endpoint's answer stay hidden.
delivery.payloadScope.note: in the delivery log, instead of a delivery's JSON
